sentinelValues.meaning: Screen size -- the coordinates of the entire screen (default).
Screen work area -- the usable area, excluding the taskbar/menu bar/Dock.

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Returns the global screen coordinates (left, top, right, bottom) of the screen designated by screenID and screenArea.
overloadMerges.note: autoparse defaulted left/top/right/bottom's direction to 'in'; the doc arrow column marks them as out-parameters filled by the command. Added sentinelValues for the screenArea selector constants.

constraints: If screenID is omitted, coordinates for the main screen are returned.
If an invalid screenID or screenArea value is given, zero is returned for all four coordinates.
If the taskbar/dock is set to auto-hide, the command always returns the entire screen size regardless of screenArea.
